blk_introduction.text: One question will follow you all day: is she tall enough for this ride? You will walk through one real day at the park.
You will enter on Buena Vista Street, check three rides and their height limits, and eat a popular snack. Then you will choose Mickey ears and finish with World of Color.

blk_part_1_part_1_8_00_a_m_through_the_g.text: It is 8:00 a.m.  You and Hana walk up to the main gate. Before you go in, look up. The gate building has a big, rounded shape. It looks like the Pan-Pacific Auditorium, a famous old building.

When the park rebuilt this area, it moved the main gate further out. So the gate now stands in front of a whole new street. That street is Buena Vista Street, and it is the first thing you see inside.

Hana points to a red car moving slowly down the street. This is the Red Car Trolley, and it runs along Buena Vista Street. She wants to ride it right away. You smile and say, "Later." First, you want to plan the rides while the morning is still quiet.

blk_part_2_part_2_9_00_a_m_to_11_00_a_m_.text: At 9:00 a.m., you walk into Cars Land. Radiator Springs Racers comes from the 2006 film Cars. Six people sit in one car. Your car races another car, and the winner is random. You cannot plan to win. The ride was also very expensive to build. It is the most expensive attraction at Disneyland Resort and one of the most expensive in the world. Before you join the line, check the height sign at the entrance or in the app. Hana stands next to it to make sure.

At 10:30 a.m., you reach Guardians of the Galaxy – Mission: Breakout! Riders must be at least 40 inches (102 cm) tall.  But the park warns that this ride has big drops, and it is loud and scary. The park says it is best for teens and adults. So you must decide as her parent.

Next comes the Incredicoaster, a fast steel roller coaster. It launches forward instead of slowly climbing up. It is the only coaster at Disneyland Resort that turns riders upside down. It is also the fastest, at 55 mph (about 89 km/h). Riders must be at least 48 inches (122 cm) tall.
Lines can be long at busy rides. You may also hear the name Lightning Lane. Before you pay for anything, open the app. Read what Lightning Lane offers and what it costs on that day.
is my daughter tall enough for this ride?
How long is the wait right now?
Thanks for telling me before we wait.

blk_part_3_part_3_12_30_p_m_lunch_at_cor.text: You go to Corn Dog Castle, a snack stand. Its cheese stick is one of the park's most popular snacks.

The park does not print one price for everyone online, so look first. Before you order, check the price on the menu board or in the Disneyland app. You can also order and pay for food in the app. That can save time when the stand is busy. Today you order at the counter so Hana can watch.
There are bigger meals in the park too. Some guests make dining reservations for a sit-down lunch. But for a fast snack between rides, a stand like Corn Dog Castle works well.

blk_part_4_part_4_3_00_p_m_choosing_mick.text: At 3:00 p.m., you walk into a gift shop. Hana goes straight to the ear headbands. These are the famous Mickey and Minnie ears. A news report from October 2026 says these headbands now cost about $38.99. Before the price increase, they cost $36.99.

That is not cheap, so you think before you buy. One headband costs about $38.99. Two headbands cost about $77.98. Maybe Hana gets one pair, and you take photos of her wearing them. For a small gift for her friend at home, look at the price tag on each item. Then compare before you choose.
How much are the Mickey ears?
Can she try them on first?

blk_part_5_part_5_evening_world_of_color.text: The park has character meet and greets with Mickey and others, along with parades and shows. Before the show, Hana meets Mickey. She shows him her new ears.
The big evening show is World of Color. The time can change from day to day, so check it in the Disneyland app. Then find your place early. Hana sits on your lap, tired but excited.

When the show ends, you walk back to the gate. Buena Vista Street is lit up at night, and Hana is quiet now. You pass the spot where the Red Car Trolley runs. You walk out under the big, rounded gate. She is holding your hand again, just like this morning.

blk_scene_1_the_height_check_at_guardian.text: You and Hana stand at the entrance to Guardians of the Galaxy – Mission: Breakout!
Your goal is to find out if Hana can ride. Learn how scary the ride is and ask about the Incredicoaster before you wait.

blk_scene_2_ordering_at_corn_dog_castle.text: You stand at the counter of Corn Dog Castle. Maria is the cashier.
Your goal is to order two cheese sticks, check the price, pay and finish your order.

blk_scene_3_choosing_ears_in_the_gift_sh.text: Hana is excited in front of the ear headbands.
Your goal is to check the price, let Hana try the ears and buy one pair.

blk_speaking_task.text: Work with a partner. Tell the story of Hana's day in time order, from the morning to the night. Explain which rides Hana could ride and why. Then change roles. Your partner is a Cast Member, and you ask about one ride, one snack and one souvenir.
